tagline.en_US: Open WebUI is an extensible, self-hosted user interface designed to run entirely offline.

description.en_US: Open WebUI is an extensible, self-hosted user interface designed to run entirely offline. It connects to local large language models through Ollama and supports OpenAI-compatible APIs for both local and cloud models. The platform provides a unified environment to chat with models, manage AI interactions, and run private AI workflows.
